owner_comment_themes_for_features_gate: part-plane consistency: drawn coplanar features built on different planes (flowers, leaves, rocket flaps)
attach semantics: flaps/wheels/chassis must be recognized as different components that are ATTACHED (floating or mere contact rejected in principle, though printability gate already catches union)
curve/contour fidelity of characteristic silhouette (lamp shade curve, handlebar curve, person arm angle)
decorative openings: headlights/grille 'mostly there' is acceptable to owner; exact count demands over-block
orientation of characteristic parts relative to the drawing (base wide-side-down, shade opening direction) - judged gestalt, not per-view veto
decisions: KEEP physical gates (watertight, one-solid, inversion, build-envelope) as SHIP blockers regardless of human lens: they encode printability, which the human grading lens deliberately ignores (owner PASSed a 2-component build).
Machine 'accepted' corresponds to owner ALMOST at best -> rename verdict tiers SHIP/ALMOST/FAIL in product surface.

Do NOT re-tune global thresholds on n=41 single-cases (aspect 0.40 -> wider would unblock 2 fixtures but re-admit the original 51%-mismatch lamp class; rescue-rotation gate still catches that — pending measured A/B).

The discriminator owner uses (planes, attachment semantics, characteristic curves, pose) is not measured by any current gate -> features gate is THE next build; fixtures = these 10 cells + their notes.
